The [[Tapani Federation]]'s '''Senate''' was the largest and most powerful of the "lesser" councils and was mandated to deliberate on such matters as tariffs, armaments, negotiations, taxes and laws. It was made up of 80 senior [[Great Council (Tapani Federation)|Great Council]] members and a number of appointed military officers and [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]]. The [[Prime Minister (Tapani Federation)|Prime Minister]] also presided over the Senate.<ref name="LE" />
